steps.title: Prepare Replicate Reactions
steps.instruction: Set up four replicate reactions using a non-precious, bulk sample that is representative of the actual samples to be processed.

steps.title: Perform Fragmentation
steps.instruction: Fragment the samples using the following temperature and time combinations:

substeps.instruction: Fragment two samples at 37 °C for 00:05:00 and 00:10:00, respectively.
Fragment the other two samples at 30 °C for 00:05:00 and 00:10:00, respectively.

steps.title: Evaluate Library Size Distribution
steps.instruction: Complete the library construction process and evaluate the size distribution of the final libraries electrophoretically.

steps.title: Optimize Fragmentation Parameters
steps.instruction: Adjust fragmentation parameters based on the observed mode fragment length:

substeps.instruction: If the mode fragment length at 37 °C for 00:10:00 is too long, increase the fragmentation time at 37 °C.
If the mode fragment length at 30 °C for 00:10:00 is too long, but 00:05:00 at 37 °C resulted in over-fragmentation, increase the fragmentation time at 30 °C.
If 00:05:00 at 30 °C resulted in over-fragmentation, perform a second set of reactions at 25 °C (e.g., for 5 min, 10 min, 15 min, and 20 min) and fine-tune the fragmentation time.
